author: Aldo Toledo
title: Antioch man arrested in gang-related shooting, police say - NewsBreak
text:
By Aldo Toledo ,
3 hours ago Eric Washington was taken into custody Tuesday after Antioch and Pittsburg police SWAT teams served what they described as a high-risk warrant at a home in the 4500 block of Wolf Way. (Antioch Police Department) A 26-year-old Antioch man was arrested and charged this week in connection with a gang-motivated shooting from three years ago, police said.
Eric Washington was taken into custody Tuesday without incident after Antioch and Pittsburg police SWAT teams served what they described as a high-risk warrant at a home in the 4500 block of Wolf Way. He was booked into the Martinez Detention Facility.
The shooting happened on June 17, 2023, near Lone Tree Way and Country Hills Drive. Antioch police said two people were leaving a gas station in the 4100 block of Lone Tree Way when occupants of another vehicle confronted them about one victim’s suspected gang affiliation.
As the victims tried to drive away, a suspect fired at least nine rounds into their vehicle, shattering the rear window and causing the car to crash into a center median, police said. No one was injured.
Detectives identified Washington as the suspected shooter after reviewing surveillance video, gathering witness statements and collecting other evidence, according to police.
The Contra Costa County District Attorney’s Office charged him with attempted murder, assault with a semiautomatic firearm and shooting at an occupied vehicle.
Washington had an outstanding felony arrest warrant, with bail set at $950,000.
Police said the warrant service was classified as high-risk because of the alleged offenses, his suspected involvement in a gang and the fact that investigators had not recovered the firearm used in the 2023 shooting.
